moments.title: I'm A Celebrity... is back!
moments.blurb: The 26th series of I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! kicked off on Monday, November 16th, with a fresh batch of celebrities entering the Australian jungle, including former England footballer Wayne Rooney and Gavin & Stacey actress Joanna Page.

angles.name: Jungle life
angles.copy: Who's already proving to be the King or Queen of the Jungle? I'm A Celebrity... is well underway and the trials are getting tougher! Who are you backing?

angles.name: Welsh talent
angles.copy: Our very own Joanna Page has swapped Barry Island for the Australian jungle! How do you think she's faring in I'm A Celebrity...?

angles.name: Rooney in the jungle
angles.copy: From the football pitch to Bushtucker Trials! Wayne Rooney is facing his toughest challenge yet in I'm A Celebrity... Is he a dark horse for the crown?

moments.title: Black Friday is almost here!
moments.blurb: Black Friday officially falls on Friday, November 27th, but many UK retailers have already started or will begin their sales earlier, offering discounts across various categories.

angles.name: Early deals
angles.copy: Black Friday is officially next Friday, but the deals have already started! Keep your eyes peeled for those early discounts.

angles.name: Shopping tips
angles.copy: Planning your Black Friday strategy? Don't get caught out! Make a list, check prices, and grab those genuine bargains. What's on your wishlist?

moments.title: Cyber Monday approaches
moments.blurb: Following Black Friday, Cyber Monday will take place on Monday, November 30th, marking another major day for online shopping deals, particularly in electronics and tech.

angles.name: Online deals
angles.copy: The deals don't stop with Black Friday! Get ready for Cyber Monday on November 30th for more online bargains, especially on tech. What are you hoping to snag?

moments.title: UK Christmas Markets are open!
moments.blurb: Festive Christmas markets are now open across the UK, including major cities like Birmingham, Manchester, York, Edinburgh, and London's Hyde Park Winter Wonderland.

angles.name: Festive fun
angles.copy: The UK's Christmas markets are officially open for business! From Birmingham's German market to Hyde Park's Winter Wonderland, where are you heading for some festive cheer?

angles.name: Local markets
angles.copy: Cardiff's Christmas Market is lighting up the city centre! What's your favourite stall to visit for a mulled wine or a unique gift?

angles.name: Yorkshire markets
angles.copy: York and Leeds Christmas Markets are in full swing! Wrap up warm and enjoy the crafts, food, and festive atmosphere across Yorkshire.

moments.title: Good Charlotte live in London
moments.blurb: American pop-punk band Good Charlotte are performing tonight, November 19th, at The O2 in London.

angles.name: Pop-punk legends
angles.copy: Good Charlotte are hitting The O2 tonight! Who's ready to relive those pop-punk anthems live in London?

moments.title: Shinedown rock Wembley
moments.blurb: American rock band Shinedown are playing tonight, November 19th, at the OVO Arena Wembley in London.

angles.name: Rock night
angles.copy: Tonight, Shinedown bring their massive rock sound to OVO Arena Wembley! Who's heading to London for the show?

moments.title: Enter Shikari at Ally Pally
moments.blurb: British rock band Enter Shikari are set to play two nights at Alexandra Palace in London on Friday, November 20th and Saturday, November 21st.

angles.name: Shikari weekend
angles.copy: Enter Shikari take over Alexandra Palace this weekend! Two nights of their electrifying live show – who's got tickets for Friday or Saturday?

moments.title: The Script play The O2
moments.blurb: Irish rock band The Script will perform at The O2 in London on Saturday, November 21st.

angles.name: Saturday night with The Script
angles.copy: The Script are bringing their anthems to The O2 this Saturday! Get ready for a night of singalongs in London.

moments.title: Happy Birthday, Björk!
moments.blurb: Iconic Icelandic singer, songwriter, and producer Björk turns 61 on Saturday, November 21st.

angles.name: Unique sound
angles.copy: Celebrating the incomparable Björk, who turns 61 this Saturday! Her unique sound has shaped music for decades. What's your favourite track?

moments.title: Deep Purple play The O2
moments.blurb: Rock legends Deep Purple are continuing their UK tour with a show at The O2 in London on Sunday, November 22nd.

angles.name: Rock legends live
angles.copy: Deep Purple are bringing their iconic rock anthems to The O2 this Sunday! Who's ready for some 'Smoke on the Water' live?

moments.title: England Rugby vs South Africa
moments.blurb: England's Autumn Nations Series continues this Sunday, November 22nd, as they face South Africa in what's expected to be a thrilling encounter.

angles.name: Twickenham clash
angles.copy: It's a huge one this Sunday! England take on South Africa in the Autumn Nations Series. Who do you think will come out on top?

moments.title: Happy Birthday, Bette Midler!
moments.blurb: The legendary 'Divine Miss M', Bette Midler, celebrates her 81st birthday on Tuesday, December 1st.

angles.name: Divine Miss M
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 81st birthday to the one and only Bette Midler on December 1st! Her voice and wit are truly timeless. What's your favourite Bette moment?

moments.title: Happy Birthday, Jay-Z!
moments.blurb: Hip-hop mogul and icon Jay-Z, born Shawn Carter, will turn 57 on Friday, December 4th.

angles.name: Hova turns 57
angles.copy: On December 4th, we celebrate the birthday of a true legend, Jay-Z, who turns 57! What's your go-to track from the Blueprint?

moments.title: Happy Birthday, Dionne Warwick!
moments.blurb: Legendary singer Dionne Warwick, known for her collaborations with Burt Bacharach, will celebrate her 86th birthday on Saturday, December 12th.

angles.name: Timeless voice
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 86th birthday to the incredible Dionne Warwick on December 12th! Her timeless voice and classic hits continue to captivate. What's your favourite?
